text.id: Pelabuhan Kali Adem. Loket kapal penumpang ditutup pake rolling door. Kertas di depannya ditulis tangan. "SEMUA KEBERANGKATAN DIBATALKAN."
text.en: The Kali Adem ferry port. The ticket window is shut behind a roller door. The paper taped to it is handwritten. "ALL DEPARTURES CANCELLED."

text.id: Tasya dateng pake jas hujan plastik kebesaran, rambutnya basah, es kopinya udah jadi kopi biasa.
text.en: Tasya shows up in an oversized plastic raincoat, her hair soaked, her iced coffee now just coffee.

text.id: Mobil kantor Bentang parkir di ujung. Dua orang, sama polisi. Mereka juga nunggu.
text.en: Bentang's company car is parked at the far end. Two men, with the police. They're waiting too.

text.id: Didit nggak bakal nunggu sampai besok. Dia orang yang selalu punya jalan lain.
text.en: Didit won't wait until tomorrow. He's the kind of man who always has another way.

text.id: Laki-laki pake jas hujan kuning nyamperin. Speedboat wisata, mesin dua, berani jalan sekarang. "Tiga juta, Bang. Satu jam nyampe Pari. Sebelum mereka."
text.en: A man in a yellow raincoat comes over. A tourist speedboat, two engines, he'll go now. "Three million, man. Pari in an hour. Before them."

text.id: Tasya megang lengan jas hujan lo.
text.en: Tasya grips the sleeve of your raincoat.
"We wait for the first ferry. Together."

text.id: Oke. Bareng. Sekar bilang lo selalu kabur kalau berat. Ternyata lo bisa nunggu juga.
text.en: Okay. Together. Sekar said you always run when things get heavy. Turns out you can wait too.
